# Squizzy Studio - root build.
# Agents: DO NOT edit this file to add your component. Subprojects are auto-discovered:
#   ui/                            -> single component (always built: the shell links sq::ui)
#   engine/ formats/ tools/        -> parent dirs that auto-discover engine/<x>/ etc.
#   services/*/                    -> every child with a CMakeLists.txt
#   third_party/*/                 -> vendored libs, EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL (built only when linked)
# Component filter (configure time):  -DSQ_ONLY="engine/doc;services/codec-wav"  (empty = all)
#                                     -DSQ_SKIP="services/foo;engine/bar"
# Core (sdk, platform, app, ui, tests, services/dummy) is always included.
# See docs/CONTRACTS.md section 3.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)

include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cmake/SqVersion.cmake)
project(SquizzyStudio VERSION ${SQ_VERSION} LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

set(SQ_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${SQ_ROOT}/cmake")

option(SQ_BUILD_TESTS "Build and register tests" ON)
option(SQ_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS "Treat warnings as errors" OFF)
set(SQ_SKIP_SERVICES "" CACHE STRING "Semicolon list of services/<name> dirs to skip (legacy; same as SQ_SKIP=services/<name>)")
set(SQ_ONLY "" CACHE STRING "Semicolon list of component ids to build (engine, engine/<x>, formats/<x>, tools/<x>, services/<x>); empty = everything")
set(SQ_SKIP "" CACHE STRING "Semicolon list of component ids to exclude (wins over SQ_ONLY)")

# ---- output layout --------------------------------------------------------------
set(SQ_BIN_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
set(SQ_SERVICES_DIR "${SQ_BIN_DIR}/services")
set(SQ_TEST_MODULES_DIR "${SQ_BIN_DIR}/testmodules")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${SQ_BIN_DIR}")
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${SQ_BIN_DIR}")
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib")
foreach(cfg IN ITEMS Debug Release RelWithDebInfo MinSizeRel)
  string(TOUPPER ${cfg} CFG)
  set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${CFG} "${SQ_BIN_DIR}")
  set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${CFG} "${SQ_BIN_DIR}")
  set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${CFG} "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib")
endforeach()
if(APPLE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH "@loader_path")
elseif(UNIX)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH "$ORIGIN")
endif()

# ---- version / ABI stamp ---------------------------------------------------------
set(SQ_BUILD_STAMP "${SQ_VERSION}+abi${SQ_ABI_MAJOR}.${SQ_ABI_MINOR}")
if(DEFINED ENV{GITHUB_SHA})
  string(SUBSTRING "$ENV{GITHUB_SHA}" 0 10 _sha)
  set(SQ_BUILD_STAMP "${SQ_BUILD_STAMP}.${_sha}")
endif()
set(SQ_GENERATED_INCLUDE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated/include")
configure_file("${SQ_ROOT}/cmake/version.h.in" "${SQ_GENERATED_INCLUDE}/sq/version.h" @ONLY)

include(SqHelpers)
enable_testing()

# ---- core (owned by the M0 skeleton) ---------------------------------------------
add_subdirectory(sdk)
add_subdirectory(platform)
if(SQ_BUILD_TESTS)
  add_subdirectory(tests/framework)
endif()

sq_component_filter_init()

# ---- vendored third-party libs (only compiled when something links them) ---------
file(GLOB _tp_dirs LIST_DIRECTORIES true RELATIVE "${SQ_ROOT}/third_party" "${SQ_ROOT}/third_party/*")
list(SORT _tp_dirs)
foreach(tp IN LISTS _tp_dirs)
  if(IS_DIRECTORY "${SQ_ROOT}/third_party/${tp}" AND EXISTS "${SQ_ROOT}/third_party/${tp}/CMakeLists.txt")
    if("third_party/${tp}" IN_LIST SQ_SKIP)
      message(STATUS "sq: third_party ${tp}/ (skipped)")
    else()
      add_subdirectory(third_party/${tp} EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    endif()
  endif()
endforeach()

# License notices for the vendored libs, shipped next to the binaries (MIT/BSD notice clause).
include(SqNotices)
sq_write_third_party_notices("${SQ_BIN_DIR}/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt")

# ---- auto-discovered component dirs ----------------------------------------------
# ui/ is linked by the shell, so it is always included. engine/ formats/ tools/ are parent dirs
# whose CMakeLists call sq_add_child_components() to discover <dir>/<child>/CMakeLists.txt.
foreach(dir IN ITEMS ui engine formats tools)
  if(EXISTS "${SQ_ROOT}/${dir}/CMakeLists.txt")
    sq_component_enabled(${dir} _on)
    if(dir STREQUAL "ui" OR _on)
      message(STATUS "sq: component ${dir}/")
      add_subdirectory(${dir})
    else()
      message(STATUS "sq: component ${dir}/ (filtered out)")
    endif()
  endif()
endforeach()

file(GLOB _svc_dirs LIST_DIRECTORIES true RELATIVE "${SQ_ROOT}/services" "${SQ_ROOT}/services/*")
list(SORT _svc_dirs)
foreach(svc IN LISTS _svc_dirs)
  if(IS_DIRECTORY "${SQ_ROOT}/services/${svc}" AND EXISTS "${SQ_ROOT}/services/${svc}/CMakeLists.txt")
    sq_component_enabled(services/${svc} _on)
    if(svc STREQUAL "dummy")
      set(_on ON) # core: the M0 tests load it
    endif()
    if(NOT _on)
      message(STATUS "sq: service ${svc}/ (filtered out)")
    else()
      message(STATUS "sq: service ${svc}/")
      add_subdirectory(services/${svc})
    endif()
  endif()
endforeach()

# Remove stale modules of services that no longer exist (deleted/renamed/skipped dirs): the app
# auto-loads everything in bin/services, so a leftover DLL would keep loading silently.
get_property(_sq_svc_targets GLOBAL PROPERTY SQ_SERVICE_TARGETS)
file(GLOB _sq_built_modules "${SQ_SERVICES_DIR}/*${CMAKE_SHARED_MODULE_SUFFIX}")
foreach(_mod IN LISTS _sq_built_modules)
  get_filename_component(_stem "${_mod}" NAME_WE)
  if(NOT "svc_${_stem}" IN_LIST _sq_svc_targets)
    message(STATUS "sq: removing stale module ${_mod}")
    file(REMOVE "${_mod}" "${SQ_SERVICES_DIR}/${_stem}.pdb" "${SQ_SERVICES_DIR}/${_stem}.ilk")
  endif()
endforeach()

add_subdirectory(app)

if(SQ_BUILD_TESTS)
  add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()
